author: huy
narrative: RECORD OF INADMISSIBLE ALIEN: Subject ESTUARDO RAMIREZ-GARCIA is a 28-year-old male citizen and national of Guatemala. On 05/18/2025 at approximately 0330 hours, Border Patrol Agents assigned to the Tucson Sector encountered the subject approximately 3 miles west of the Lukeville, Arizona Port of Entry. Subject stated under oath that he crossed the international boundary on foot through the desert and was not inspected, admitted, or paroled by an immigration officer. Subject is inadmissible pursuant to Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act.

author: huy
narrative: NARRATIVE: Agency records (ENFORCE/IDENT) establish that subject YELENA IVANOVA, a native of Ukraine, was ordered removed from the United States by an Immigration Judge sitting in Detroit, Michigan on 04/10/2021 and was physically removed to Ukraine on 05/02/2021. On 07/11/2025, Border Patrol Agents encountered the subject near Portal, North Dakota, having re-entered the United States without being admitted or paroled. Subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(9)(A)(i) of the INA.

author: huy
narrative: DETAILS OF APPREHENSION: On 08/14/2024 at Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport, subject AMIR REZAIE presented a photo-substituted Italian passport bearing the name Marco Rossi to a CBP Officer in primary inspection in an attempt to procure admission as a nonimmigrant visitor. Subject willfully misrepresented his true identity and nationality, which was material to his admissibility as an Iranian national requiring a nonimmigrant visa. Subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(C)(i) of the Act.

author: huy
narrative: RECORD OF INADMISSIBILITY: Subject JORGE LUIS MENDEZ-CRUZ is a 31-year-old male citizen of El Salvador. Subject stated under oath that on 06/02/2025 he entered the United States on foot by climbing over the international border barrier during nighttime hours. Subject admitted he was not inspected, admitted, or paroled by an immigration officer. The reporting officer omitted the specific geographic place of entry. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: STATEMENT OF CHARGES: An agency records check revealed subject RICARDO TOVAR-RODRIGUEZ was previously ordered removed from the United States by an Immigration Judge in Buffalo, New York. On 09/03/2025, subject was apprehended near Port Huron, Michigan after re-entering the United States across the St. Clair River without being admitted or paroled. The record fails to document the date of prior removal. Subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(9)(A)(i) of the Act.

author: huy
narrative: NARRATIVE: On 04/22/2025 at 0615 hrs, BP Agents encountered subject HUGO ALBERTO PENA-VALLE, a citizen of Mexico, approximately 2 miles west of the Roma, Texas Port of Entry. Subject stated he entered the United States on or about 04/21/2025 and that he was not inspected, admitted, or paroled. The narrative does not document the manner of entry or method utilized to cross the border. Subject is inadmissible under INA Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: FIELD APPREHENSION REPORT: Border Patrol Agents observed subject OSCAR RIVAS-BLANCO, a national of Honduras, running northbound through desert terrain near Sasabe, Arizona on 06/19/2025 after traversing a vehicle barrier on foot. Upon being questioned, the subject stated he possessed no identification or immigration documents permitting lawful entry. The officer did not explicitly document that the subject was not admitted or paroled. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).

author: huy
narrative: RECORD OF DEPORTABLE/INADMISSIBLE ALIEN: Subject ANTOINE DUPONT is a citizen of France. Agency records confirm subject arrived at the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel POE on 02/10/2024 and was inspected and lawfully admitted by a CBP Officer as a B-2 visitor for pleasure with an authorized period of stay through 08/09/2024. Subject failed to depart the United States upon expiration of authorized stay. Officer cited INA Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) for presence in the United States without admission or parole.

author: huy
narrative: RECORD OF INADMISSIBILITY: Subject GUSTAVO MORALES-SOTO, a citizen of Colombia, was convicted on 03/12/2024 in the Third Judicial Circuit Court of Michigan (Wayne County) of delivery/manufacture of a controlled substance under MCL 333.7401. Subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(2)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act as an alien convicted of a crime involving moral turpitude.

author: huy
narrative: DETAILS OF APPREHENSION: On 07/04/2025 at approximately 2200 hrs, Border Patrol Agents on line watch duty near Nogales, Arizona apprehended subject MANUEL ENRIQUE CASTILLO, a citizen of Honduras, after observing him scale the international boundary fence. Subject admitted under oath that he entered without inspection and was not admitted or paroled by an immigration officer.
